title: 第1212章 张显第1211章 金竹坊
content_zh:
易长生视线在那面旗帜上停留了片刻，然后毫不迟疑地穿透了那栋建筑的白色石墙，探入了内部。
建筑内部的空间比他想象中要宽阔得多。
从外面看只有一层的方形建筑，内部却通过须弥芥子类的空间扩展阵法形成了一片高阔而纵深的大厅。
大厅的天花板至少有三四层楼那么高，上面绘着一幅巨大的彩色壁画，画面上是一片云雾缭绕的群山和一轮巨大的金色圆日，圆日的中央绘制着一柄同样贯穿令牌的图案，与外面旗帜上的徽记如出一辙。
大厅的地面由大块的暖黄色玉石铺就，玉石的表面打磨得光滑如镜，能清晰地映出头顶的壁画和悬挂在廊柱间的宫灯。
大厅的四面墙壁上每隔一段距离就挂着一幅字画，有的是水墨山水，有的是工笔花鸟，有的则是某种古篆体的书法作品，笔力苍劲而肆意，显然出自功力不弱的修士之手。
而此刻大厅中正举行着一场宴会。
易长生将大厅的场景尽收眼底。
大厅的正中央摆着一张巨大的紫檀木长案，案面上摆满了各色的酒菜和灵果，银盘玉盏在灯光的照耀下流转着温润的光泽。
案面两侧坐着大约十几位修士，每个人的面前都摆着自己的酒杯和餐具，有的在低声交谈，有的在举杯痛饮，有的则靠在椅背上闭目养神，神态松弛而随意。
大厅的角落里坐着数名身穿薄纱的乐师，手中各持着一种易长生从未见过的乐器，有的像是扁平的筝，有的像是长颈的琵琶，还有的是一串排列整齐的金属管。
他们的手指在那些乐器上轻轻拨弄，一阵阵舒缓而悠扬的乐声便从那些乐器中流淌出来，在大厅中回荡交织，形成了一种如同流水般温润的背景声响。
坐在大厅正中央主位上的是位穿着宽松银白色衣袍的中年男修。
他的袍服面料是一种极其柔软轻盈的银色绸缎，袍面上没有任何多余的纹饰和绣花，只在大襟和袖口处以同色的银线绣了一圈极细的云纹，那种素净的质感反而比繁复的装饰更显出几分雍容与懒散。
他的面容并不算英俊，但五官端正而开阔，眉目间带着一种长期居于上位后养成的从容与自信。
他的身材微胖但并不臃肿，靠在宽大的紫檀木交椅中时，腹部微微隆起一个放松的弧度。
他左手端着一只碧玉酒杯，杯中的酒液是一种如同琥珀般金红色的液体，在灯光下泛着一层薄薄的金色光圈。
他的右手则随意地搭在座椅扶手上，五指虚扣着扶手上雕琢成兽首形状的装饰。
而他的左右两侧，各依偎着一位容貌出众的美.艳女修。
左边的女修穿着浅粉色的纱裙，长发用一支金簪松松绾起，几缕碎发从鬓边垂落在锁骨处，在她俯身去为张显斟酒时那几缕发丝便在微光中轻轻晃动。

她斟酒的动作轻柔而熟练，酒液从银壶中倾入碧玉酒杯时拉出一道细长而均匀的金红色线流，没有溅起一滴。
右边的女修则穿着淡紫色的贴身长裙，裙摆极长，从椅面一直拖曳到地面，如同一小片流动的紫雾。
她正用一把小小的白玉梳为张显梳理着披散在肩头的长发，动作极慢极柔，白玉梳的齿尖在发丝间滑过时发出几乎听不见的细微沙沙声，像是某种催眠般的白色噪音。
张显靠在椅背上的姿态极为放松，他时而低头饮一口杯中的灵酒，时而微微侧头与左边斟酒的女修低语几句，引得那女修掩唇轻笑，脸颊微红。
他的目光带着一种微醺后的慵懒感，半阖半张，视线在大厅中缓缓扫过，如同在巡视自己领地上的悠闲君主。
大厅左右两侧分坐着十几位元婴期的修士，他们穿着各色的法袍，从衣料的质地和佩戴的法器来看，应该都是金竹坊中有头有脸的人物。
要么是在坊市中经营着大型店铺的商人，要么是占据了大片洞府的定居修士，要么是张显门下亲信的手下。
他们之间的氛围明显比主位上的张显更加活泼和随意，三五成群地低声交谈着，不时发出笑声。
有些人的杯中已经添了三四巡酒，脸颊上浮着一层淡淡的红晕，说话时的语调也比平时提高了些许。
易长生将这一切尽收眼底，将张显的样貌、衣着、姿态、举止都一一记下。
这位应该是金竹坊的坊主，现在看起来正处于一种春风得意的状态中，他的神色和肢体语言中没有任何紧张或警觉的迹象，显然对坊市的安全状况极为自信，不认为会有任何威胁能渗透到他这山顶的洞府中来。
此时，左侧一位穿着墨绿色法袍的元婴修士端起面前的酒杯，朝着张显的方向微微举起，笑道：
“这次的归元洞天程家损失一人，他们估计会收缩势力来应对陈家了。可惜这次陈家两子并没有什么损失，要是两家都有损失我们金竹坊就能轻松不少了。”
他说话的语气中带着一种明显的幸灾乐祸，说到“损失一人”时还刻意拖长了尾音，仿佛这个消息让他感到无比快意。
他身旁的几位修士也跟着笑了起来，端起酒杯互相碰了一下，酒液在杯沿间轻轻晃荡，发出清脆的叮当声。
坐在右侧首位的另一位元婴修士听了便点头接话，他的声音比墨绿袍修士低沉一些，语调更加沉稳：
“这次进入归元洞天的修士还是少了，能安然出洞天的也没有多少修士。
不像五百年前那次，那次不少修士带着好东西出来呢，听说还在长原城举行了拍卖会，那次拍卖会上据说连七阶的灵宝都出现了一件，消息传出来的时候整个下南灵域都震动了。哎！这次倒是可惜了。”
他摇头叹息着端起酒杯喝了一口，那神情中既有对当年盛况的追忆。
主位上的张显端着一杯新斟满的酒，听到两人的对话时他原本带着笑意的脸上那抹慵懒的神情微微收敛了一些，变成了一种更加专注和认真的表情。
content_en:
Yi Changsheng's eyes stayed on the flag for a moment, and then without hesitation, he penetrated the white stone wall of the building and penetrated into the interior.
The space inside the building was much wider than he imagined.
From the outside, it looks like a square building with only one floor, but inside it forms a tall, wide and deep hall through a mustard-like space expansion array.
The ceiling of the hall is at least three or four stories high, and there is a huge colorful mural painted on it. The picture shows a mist-shrouded mountain and a huge golden sun. In the center of the sun is a pattern that also runs through the token, which is exactly the same as the emblem on the flag outside.
The floor of the hall is paved with large pieces of warm yellow jade. The surface of the jade is polished as smooth as a mirror, which can clearly reflect the murals above and the palace lanterns hanging between the columns.
There are calligraphy and paintings hung at regular intervals on the four walls of the hall. Some are ink landscapes, some are meticulous flowers and birds, and some are some kind of ancient seal calligraphy works. The brushstrokes are vigorous and wanton, obviously written by monks with strong skills.
At this moment, a banquet was being held in the hall.
Yi Changsheng had a panoramic view of the scene in the hall.
In the center of the hall stood a huge long rosewood table, which was filled with various wines, dishes and spiritual fruits. The silver plates and jade cups shone with a warm luster under the light.
There were about a dozen monks sitting on both sides of the table, with their own wine glasses and tableware placed in front of each person. Some were chatting in low voices, some were drinking from their glasses, and some were leaning on the back of the chair with their eyes closed to meditate, with relaxed and casual expressions.
Sitting in the corner of the hall were several musicians dressed in gauze, each holding an instrument that Yi Changsheng had never seen before. Some were like flat zithers, some were like long-necked pipas, and some were a string of neatly arranged metal pipes.
Their fingers gently played on those instruments, and bursts of soothing and melodious music flowed out of those instruments, echoing and intertwining in the hall, forming a background sound as warm as running water.
Sitting on the main seat in the center of the hall is a middle-aged male cultivator wearing loose silver-white robes.
The fabric of his robe is an extremely soft and light silver satin. There are no unnecessary patterns or embroideries on the robe. Only a very fine cloud pattern is embroidered with silver thread of the same color on the placket and cuffs. The plain texture actually shows a bit more grace and laziness than the complicated decoration.
His face is not handsome, but his features are straight and broad, and his brows have a calmness and confidence that he has developed after being in a position of power for a long time.
His figure is slightly fat but not bloated. When he leans on the large rosewood chair, his abdomen slightly bulges in a relaxing arc.
He held a jasper wine glass in his left hand. The wine in the glass was a golden-red liquid like amber, glowing with a thin golden halo under the light.
His right hand rested casually on the armrest of the seat, and his fingers were clasping the decoration carved into the shape of an animal head on the armrest.
On his left and right sides, there was a beautiful and gorgeous female cultivator with outstanding appearance.
The female nun on the left is wearing a light pink gauze skirt, her long hair is loosely tied with a gold hairpin, and a few strands of hair hang from the temples to the collarbone. When she leans over to pour wine for Zhang Xian, the strands of hair sway gently in the dim light.
She poured the wine gently and skillfully. When the wine was poured from the silver pot into the jasper wine glass, a long and even golden-red line flowed out, without even a drop being splashed.
The female cultivator on the right is wearing a lilac long, close-fitting skirt with an extremely long hem that drags from the chair to the ground, like a small piece of flowing purple mist.
She was using a small white jade comb to comb Zhang Xian's long hair that was scattered around his shoulders. Her movements were very slow and gentle. When the teeth of the white jade comb slid through the hair, it made an almost inaudible rustling sound, like some kind of hypnotic white noise.
Zhang Xian leaned on the back of the chair in an extremely relaxed posture. He sometimes lowered his head to take a sip of the spiritual wine in the cup, and sometimes smiled slightly.He tilted his head slightly and whispered a few words to the female cultivator on the left who was pouring wine, causing the female cultivator to cover her lips and chuckle, her cheeks slightly red.
His eyes had a drunken laziness, half closed and half opened, and his eyes slowly swept across the hall, like a leisurely monarch patrolling his territory.
There are more than a dozen Nascent Soul stage monks sitting on the left and right sides of the hall. They are wearing robes of various colors. Judging from the texture of the clothes and the magical instruments they wear, they should all be prominent figures in Jinzhufang.
Either they were businessmen who ran large shops in the market, or they were settled monks who occupied a large area of ​​caves, or they were the subordinates of Zhang Xian's close followers.
The atmosphere between them was obviously more lively and casual than that of Zhang Xian in the main seat. They talked in small groups in low voices and laughed from time to time.
Some people had already filled their glasses with three or four rounds of wine, a faint blush appeared on their cheeks, and their tone of voice was slightly higher than usual when they spoke.
Yi Changsheng took in all of this and wrote down Zhang Xian's appearance, clothes, posture, and behavior one by one.
This person, who should be the owner of Jinzhufang, seems to be in a state of elation now. There is no sign of nervousness or alertness in his expression and body language. He is obviously very confident in the safety of the city and does not think that any threats can penetrate his cave on the top of the mountain.
At this time, a Nascent Soul monk wearing a dark green robe on the left picked up the wine glass in front of him, raised it slightly in the direction of Zhang Xian, and said with a smile:
"The Cheng family in Guiyuan Cave lost one person this time. They will probably shrink their power to deal with the Chen family. Unfortunately, the two Chen family members did not suffer any losses this time. If both families suffered losses, our Jinzhufang would be much more relaxed."
There was an obvious sense of schadenfreude in his tone of voice, and when he said "lost one person", he deliberately prolonged the ending, as if the news made him feel extremely happy.
Several monks beside him also laughed, and they raised their wine glasses and clinked them with each other. The wine swayed gently between the rims of the glasses, making a crisp tinkling sound.
Another Nascent Soul cultivator sitting at the top on the right nodded and answered. His voice was lower than that of the dark green-robed cultivator, and his tone was calmer:
"There are still fewer monks entering Guiyuan Cave this time, and not many monks can leave the cave safely.
Unlike the time five hundred years ago, when many monks came out with good things, I heard that an auction was held in Changyuan City. At that auction, it was said that even a seventh-level spiritual treasure appeared. When the news came out, the entire Lower South Spiritual Realm was shocked. Hey! It's a pity this time. "
He shook his head and sighed, picked up the wine glass and took a sip, his expression recalling the grand occasion of that year.
Zhang Xian, who was sitting at the main seat, was holding a newly filled glass of wine. When he heard the conversation between the two, the lazy expression on his originally smiling face softened slightly and turned into a more focused and serious expression.
